about_short_description.short_description: Reshape Biotech builds lab robots that automate the everyday tasks of microbiologists, from filling plates to analyzing images.

product.name: Reshape Imaging Device
product.description: An automated imaging system that captures high-resolution time-lapse images of plate-based experiments and provides real-time AI analysis for microbiological assays.

product.name: Reshape Discovery Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that centralizes plate-based experiment data, providing instant AI-driven analysis and remote accessibility.

product.name: Reshape API
product.description: An API that enables integration of Reshape’s data and analysis results with external lab information management systems and workflows.

product.name: Automated Colony Forming Unit (CFU) Counting
product.description: An AI-powered application for automated counting of microbial colonies on plates to improve accuracy and throughput.

product.name: Radial Growth Rate Assay
product.description: An AI-based assay for precise and time-resolved measurement of microbial radial growth on plates.

product.name: Fluorescence Assay Automation
product.description: Automates fluorescence-based assays on various plate formats with AI-powered image capture and analysis to increase throughput.
